criteria.description: The bounded Phase 1 kernel acceptance matrix has current executable evidence.
criteria.limitations: The evidence covers the local contract-first kernel and not deferred runtime integrations.

criteria.description: Regression, isolation, security and provenance risks have current checks and no open Critical or High findings.
criteria.limitations: Historical raw skill-audit fixture links remain outside the runtime scope and are intentionally untouched.

criteria.description: Deferred scope, authority boundary and residual risks are explicit and prevent an overbroad completion claim.
criteria.limitations: A separate human-authorized Phase 2 gate is required before adding execution or external integrations.

authority.decision: No external approval is required for this local, reversible, bounded implementation.
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate on any execution, provider, host, deployment, credential or material scope change.

next_action: Do not expand runtime scope until a separate Phase 2 specification, authority and execution gate is approved.
revalidation_triggers: Adding an executor, provider dispatch, host integration or persistence
Changing capability provenance or project-isolation policy
Changing the Phase 1 contract or security boundary
Moving from local verification to release or production operation
